title: Readiness probe path /healthz not served (service exposes /health)
executive_summary: Run 20261107-203929-partial PARTIAL SUCCESS: 'Integration & deployment validation' failed (probe /healthz -> 404; 1 failed, 5 passed). Root cause (95% confidence): Readiness probe path /healthz not served (service exposes /health). 5 earlier stages passed and their outputs are reusable (artifact artifacts/order-service-1.4.0.tar.gz (sha256 115f03b21c61)). Production impact: None. Failure was caught in isolated local staging validation. A minimal fix is proposed and awaits human approval.
root_cause: The latest commit changed health_path in config/deploy.json from /health to /healthz. The service (app/service.py) only serves /health, so the platform's readiness probe gets HTTP 404 and the deployment can never become ready. Application code and the artifact are healthy: all other integration and contract tests pass.

evidence.finding: readiness probe returned 404 for the manifest's health_path

evidence.excerpt: AssertionError: readiness probe GET /healthz returned HTTP 404

evidence.finding: service itself is healthy: 5 integration tests passed, including the /health health contract
config/deploy.json line 5 changed in the failing commit
artifact built and checksummed before the failure - reusable

blast_radius: config/deploy.json (environment config, not packaged in the artifact)
platform readiness probe and rollout gating for order-service
no application code affected; artifact sha256 unchanged
impact.customer_impact: If promoted, pods would never pass readiness: rollout stalls or restart-loops and capacity drops during deploy.
impact.production_impact: None. Failure was caught in isolated local staging validation.

recommendation: Point the manifest back at the served route: set health_path to /health in config/deploy.json. Config-only, one line, no rebuild needed.
fix_guide: Re-run ONLY the integration & deployment-validation stage against the existing artifact.
If it passes, re-run the full pipeline for a clean, auditable green build.
If /healthz is a genuine platform convention, raise a separate change to add the route in app/service.py together with contract tests - do not mix that into this fix.
alternatives_considered: Add a /healthz route to the service - rejected for auto-fix: code change, needs rebuild and a contract decision; broader than necessary.

proposed_changes.reason: align readiness probe with served route

validation_plan: Safety gate: allow-list, file-hash precondition, change-size limit, syntax check of config/deploy.json
Targeted rerun: Integration & deployment validation (reusing the already-built artifact)
Full pipeline rerun (all 7 stages) on the patched workspace
Success is declared only if the full rerun status is SUCCESS
rollback_plan: Automatic: if targeted or full validation fails, restore the byte-for-byte backups and log it
Source control: the patch is saved as a .diff; revert it like any commit

confidence_factors.signal: probe path absent from service routes with a close match present
404 (not 5xx/timeout) - service is up, path is wrong
